extensions.name: Thread Summary
extensions.description: Summarizes a long mail or a whole thread on demand, with the key points and anything that looks like it needs doing
extensions.author: Sarv

extensions.name: One-Time Passcodes
extensions.description: Spots verification codes as they arrive and shows them with a copy button and a countdown, so you never open the mail to read six digits.
extensions.author: Sarv

screenshots.caption: The code appears in the corner the moment the mail lands, with a copy button and a live countdown
Copying the code marks that message read, in whichever mailbox you are looking at

extensions.name: VIP Senders
extensions.description: Learns who actually matters to you from your own mailbox and tags their mail vip as it arrives. No AI, no network, no list to maintain by hand.
extensions.author: Sarv

screenshots.caption: Mail from people you actually reply to carries a vip tag in the list
The same tag sits under the subject in the reading pane, and behaves like any other label
